# GSLHub

> Generative Search Lab Hub is an independent applied research initiative based in Barcelona with international scope.

## Main website
- https://gslhub.com/

## Research areas
- Generative Search and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Applied Artificial Intelligence
- Automation and Digital Transformation
- Open Software and Reproducible Research

## Public repositories
- https://github.com/gslhub

## Contact
- research@gslhub.com
